verses.sanskrit:
जनमेजय उवाच।
              दिशामभिजयं ब्रह्मन्विस्तरेणानुकीर्तय। न हि तृप्यामि पूर्वेषां शृण्वानश्चरितं महत्॥१॥
verses.english: Janamejaya said O Brahmana, narrate to me in full the history of the conquests of the various directions (by the Pandavas). I am not satiated with listening to the great history of my ancestors.

verses.sanskrit:
वैशम्पायन उवाच।
              धनञ्जयस्य वक्ष्यामि विजयं पूर्वमेव ते। यौगपद्येन पार्थैर्हि निर्जितेयं वसुन्धरा॥२॥
verses.english: Vaishampayana said The earth was conquered simultaneously by all the sons of Pritha. I shall first describe the conquest of Dhannajaya (Arjuna).

verses.sanskrit: पूर्वं कुलिन्दविषये वशे चक्रे महीपतीन्। धनञ्जयो महाबाहुर्नातितीव्रेण कर्मणा॥३॥
verses.english: The mighty armed Dhananjaya, by the greatest courageous feats first, conquered the king of the Kulindas.

verses.sanskrit: आनर्तान्कालकूटांश्च कुलिन्दांश्च विजित्य सः। सुमण्डलं च विजितं कृतवान्सह सैनिकम्॥४॥
verses.english: Having conquered the Kulindas, the Anartas and the Kalakutas, he conquered Sumandala with his troops.

verses.sanskrit: स तेन सहितो राजन्सव्यसाची परन्तपः। विजिग्ये शाकलं द्वीपं प्रतिविन्ध्यं च पार्थिवम्॥५॥
verses.english: O king, the chastiser of foes, Savyasachi (Arjuna) conquered with him (Sumandala) the island of Shakala, and also the king Prativindhya.

verses.sanskrit: शाकलद्वीपवासाश्च सप्तद्वीपेषु ये नृपाः। अर्जुनस्य च सैन्यैस्तैर्विग्रहस्तुमुलोऽभवत्॥६॥
verses.english: Shakala was one of the seven islands of the earth, and there were many kings o that island. A fearful battle took place between them and their troops and Arjuna.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र राजा महानासीद्भगदत्तो विशाम्पते। तेनासीत्सुमहद्युद्धं पाण्डवस्य महात्मनः॥८॥
verses.english: O king, the king of that country was Bhagadatta. A great battle was fought by the illustrious Pandava with him.

verses.sanskrit: स तानपि महेष्वासान्विजिग्ये भरतर्षभ। तैरेव सहितः सर्वैः प्रग्ज्योतिषमुपाद्रवत्॥९॥
verses.english: But O best of the Bharata race, those great bowmen were all defeated by Arjuna. With them all, he then attacked the kingdom of Pragjyotisha.

verses.sanskrit: स किरातैश्च चीनैश्च वृतः प्राग्ज्योतिषोऽभवत्। अन्यैश्च बहुभिर्योधैः सागरानुपवासिभिः॥९॥
verses.english: But O best of the Bharata race, those great bowmen were all defeated by Arjuna. With them all, he then attacked the kingdom of Pragjyotisha.

verses.sanskrit: ततः स दिवसानष्टौ योधयित्वा धनञ्जयम्। प्रहसन्नब्रवीद्राजा सङ्ग्रामविगतक्लमम्॥१०॥
verses.english: Having fought with Dhananjaya (Arjuna) continuously for eight days and having found him not the least tired in the battle, the king Bhagadatta smilingly said to him.

verses.sanskrit: उपपन्नं महाबाहो त्वयि कौरवनन्दन। पाकशासनदायादे वीर्यमाहवशोभिनि॥१३॥
verses.english: "O mighty-armed (hero), O descendant of Kuru, this energy in battle is well-suited to you, (for) you are the son of the chastiser of Paka (Indra) and an ornament in battle.

verses.sanskrit: त्वमीप्सितं पाण्डवेयं ब्रूहि किं करवाणि ते। यद्वक्ष्यसि महाबाहो तत्करिष्यामि पुत्रक॥१३॥
verses.english: "O mighty-armed (hero), O descendant of Kuru, this energy in battle is well-suited to you, (for) you are the son of the chastiser of Paka (Indra) and an ornament in battle.

verses.sanskrit: अहं सखा महेन्द्रस्य शक्रादनवरो रणे। न शक्ष्यामि च ते तात स्थातुं प्रमुखतो युधि॥१४॥
verses.english: O child, I am the friend of Indra, I am scarcely inferior to him in battle, (but) I cannot stand before you.

verses.sanskrit:
अर्जुन उवाच।
              कुरूणामृषभो राजा धर्मपुत्रो युधिष्ठिरः। धर्मज्ञः सत्यसन्धश्च यज्वा विपुलदक्षिणः॥१४॥
verses.english: O child, I am the friend of Indra, I am scarcely inferior to him in battle, (but) I cannot stand before you.

verses.sanskrit: तस्य पार्थिवतामीप्से करस्तस्मै प्रदीयताम्। भवान्पितृसखा चैव प्रीयमाणो मयापि च। ततो नाज्ञापयामि त्वां प्रीतिपूर्वं प्रदीयताम्॥१५॥
verses.english: I desire to see him acquire (it) the imperial dignity. Let tribute be paid by you to him. You are my father's friend, and you have been also gratified by me. I cannot command you. Therefore, let the tribute be paid by you with cheerfulness and at your own (free) will.

verses.sanskrit:
भगदत्त उवाच।
              कुन्तीमातर्यथा मे त्वं तथा राजा युधिष्ठिरः। सर्वमेतत्करिष्यामि किं चान्यत्करवाणि ते॥१६॥
verses.english: Bhagadatta said O son of Kunti, as you are to me, so is also the king Yudhishthira. I shall do all this; tell me what else I can do for you.
